locator.name: says a bounded roster's cards cover only the loaded members and points to the walk (F2)

proves.facet: The current F2 case uses the truncated and complete captured rosters, requires a bounded loaded count and recorded maximum total, constructs disjoint sides whose identity union exceeds that total while displayed loaded count stays clamped, omits a complete scope, and renders the loaded population plus roster-walk direction. This is the asserted bounded-roster facet, not a new execution or the other describe-group cases.

locator.name: names the incomplete side when all members of the widest side are loaded

proves.facet: At equal loaded/total counts the current case still renders the named after-side missing-content reason without a load-the-rest claim; an empty after member list retains an incomplete-side notice and an unreadable after side renders its actual detail. This is the complementary partial/unavailable-content facet, not execution acceptance.
